photos.title: Maisons Sur Mer from above
photos.what: Maisons Sur Mer from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the tall stepped tower with a long shadow stands on the oceanfront in the left middle; its pool and pool deck lie between the tower and the beach; white-roofed buildings stand to the north-east and south-west; Shore Drive runs along the top left; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the bottom right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Maisons Sur Mer from above, on the oceanfront side of Shore Drive.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Maisons Sur Mer tower and its pool deck on the oceanfront in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the south-east
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
